name: Functional Map of the World (fMoW)
description: The Functional Map of the World (fMoW) is a large-scale satellite imagery dataset developed by the Intelligence Advanced Research Projects Activity (IARPA), DigitalGlobe, and Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU/APL). Created to evaluate machine learning models for predicting the functional purpose of buildings and land use, fMoW features 1,047,691 satellite images spanning more than 200 countries across 63 total categories, consisting of 62 fine-grained real-world functional categories (e.g., educational institution, airport, hospital, recreational facility) and 1 additional false-detection category (representing non-functional overhead background false alarms) with 83,412 multi-temporal facility sequences. The dataset is distributed via AWS in two format variants: fMoW-full (approx. 3.5 TB, containing 4-band and 8-band multispectral TIFF images hosted at s3://spacenet-dataset/Hosted-Datasets/fmow/fmow-full/) and fMoW-rgb (approx. 200 GB, containing 3-band JPEG images hosted at s3://spacenet-dataset/Hosted-Datasets/fmow/fmow-rgb/). fMoW-full and fMoW-rgb represent format variants of the same canonical research dataset.

Confirmed 1,047,691 images across 63 categories (62 real-world functional categories + 1 false-detection label), distinct S3 download endpoints (s3://spacenet-dataset/Hosted-Datasets/fmow/fmow-full/ and s3://spacenet-dataset/Hosted-Datasets/fmow/fmow-rgb/ with manifest.json.bz2), and non-commercial license.

size.notes: Available in two official format variants on AWS: fMoW-full at s3://spacenet-dataset/Hosted-Datasets/fmow/fmow-full/ (~3.5 TB multispectral TIFF) and fMoW-rgb at s3://spacenet-dataset/Hosted-Datasets/fmow/fmow-rgb/ (~200 GB JPEG), each cataloged with manifest.json.bz2.

provenance.collection_method: High-resolution satellite imagery gathered by DigitalGlobe satellites over 200 countries paired with rich metadata including sun angles, GSD, and timestamps.
provenance.curation_notes: Annotated across 63 categories (62 fine-grained functional categories plus 1 false-detection label). fMoW-full provides raw 4-band and 8-band multispectral TIFFs; fMoW-rgb provides down-sampled 3-band JPEG representations of the exact same images.
